description.value:
Gets you down on your luck. Hard. For when things go very, very wrong.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Whenever this weapon performs an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6), and when rolling for its Aimed Shot damage, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries.

Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, the user rolls 1d6 and also applies an additional effect as according to the following list:

1. Roll on this list until you get two different results higher than 1. Both results occur.

2. For the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds), the victim suffers a -3 penalty to MOVE (Minimum 0).

3. The victim is set Strongly on Fire (4 HP damage a turn).

4. The victim is knocked Prone and suffers the Cracked Skull Critical Injury, even if the Attack wasn’t aimed at their Head.

5. For the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds), the victim suffers a -2 penalty to REF and DEX (Minimum 0) and cannot dodge Ranged Attacks.

6. The user gains a +5 bonus to the next Attack Check they make with this weapon.

If using the Night City Tarot DLC, when this weapon incurs a Tarot, the user draws three cards from the deck and chooses one to use. The two unused cards are re-added to the deck as if they had not been drawn.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
